scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @table/shared build && pnpm --parallel -r --filter server --filter client --filter @table/mcp dev
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @table/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter server exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter client exec tsc -b --pretty false && pnpm --filter @table/mcp exec tsc --noEmit
